provenance: H100 inventory capture; excerpts keep selected lines. gpu-proc is explicitly a source-format example, not captured output.

items.output:
9d:00.0 3D controller [0302]: NVIDIA Corporation GH100 [H100 SXM5 80GB] [10de:2330] (rev a1)
	DeviceName: GPU4
	Subsystem: NVIDIA Corporation GH100 [H100 SXM5 80GB] [10de:16c1]
	Kernel driver in use: nvidia
	Kernel modules: nvidiafb, nvidia_drm, nvidia
items.note_zh: 9d:00.0 是 PCI 地址；10de:2330 是厂商与设备 ID。Kernel driver in use 才是当前绑定的驱动，Kernel modules 列出候选模块。
items.note_en: 9d:00.0 is the PCI address; 10de:2330 is the vendor/device ID. Kernel driver in use is the bound driver; Kernel modules lists candidates.

items.note_zh: 从采集输出选取四个模块的前三列：模块名、大小、引用计数。引用计数不是 GPU 利用率，也不等同于使用 GPU 的进程数。
items.note_en: The excerpt selects four modules and their first three columns: name, size and reference count. The count is neither GPU utilization nor a GPU process count.

items.note_zh: -F 只输出指定字段。modinfo nvidia 可查看文件路径、版本、许可证和依赖等完整元数据；运行中的版本另看 /proc。
items.note_en: -F selects one field. modinfo nvidia lists metadata including the file path, version, license and dependencies. Check /proc for the running version.

items.output:
NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX Open Kernel Module for x86_64  615.71.10
GCC version:  gcc version 13.3.0 (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04)
items.note_zh: Open Kernel Module 表示开放内核模块；615.71.10 是已加载驱动版本。摘录省略了构建主机和构建时间。
items.note_en: Open Kernel Module identifies the open module; 615.71.10 is the loaded version. Build-host and build-time fields are omitted.

items.note_zh: 三列依次是型号、驱动版本、PCI 地址；csv,noheader 省略表头。此任务返回一张可见 H100，PCI 地址可与 lspci 对照。
items.note_en: Columns are GPU model, driver version and PCI address. csv,noheader omits headings. This task sees one H100; compare its PCI address with lspci.

items.note_en: This file was not captured in the run; the example shows source-defined field names. Bus Location is the PCI address; Device Minor is N in /dev/nvidiaN. The wildcard may concatenate multiple GPUs.

items.output:
crw-rw-rw- 1 root root   497,   0 Nov  7 09:24 /dev/nvidia-uvm
crw-rw-rw- 1 root root   195,   0 Nov  7 09:24 /dev/nvidia0
crw-rw-rw- 1 root root   195,   1 Nov  7 09:24 /dev/nvidia1
crw-rw-rw- 1 root root   195, 255 Nov  7 09:24 /dev/nvidiactl
items.note_zh: 行首 c 表示字符设备；195, 255 等两列为 major/minor。这里 UVM 的 major 是 497，其他机器可以不同。权限列控制谁能打开节点。
items.note_en: The leading c means character device; numbers such as 195, 255 are major/minor. UVM has major 497 here; it can differ on other hosts. Mode bits control access.

items.note_zh: 本行 major 为 226，minor 为 128，所属组为 render。ls -l /dev/dri/ 可列出整个目录；这里筛选 render 节点，并仅摘录第一行。
items.note_en: This node has major 226, minor 128 and group render. ls -l /dev/dri/ lists the whole directory; this command selects render nodes, with the first line shown.

items.note_en: The left column is the major number; the right column is its registered name. Match it to ls -l to connect device nodes to driver registrations.
